messages:
sam: heads-up — during the eu-west warm-pool reshuffle at ~09:14 we saw a cluster-wide 18-25% tail latency spike for small-gen workloads. seemed correlated with a wave of shadow drains and a lot of tiny rebalances.

maya: saw the same. metrics show KV cache miss rate jumped and GPU utilization variance spiked on a subset of hosts.

jon: can you paste the drain rollout command that triggered it?

sam: we rolled a new placement policy to prefer fractional slices on older A100s: `PATCH /pools/eu-west/placement` + canary flag. ops-bot logged the orchestration: `started 120 drains -> stagger 3s`

infra-bot: alert: unit 10.23.7.* reported 503-window increase during scheduled drains. stacktrace attached to incident 3268.

elena: my hypothesis — stagger too tight, small slices cause more frequent KV cache evictions because requests hop hosts mid-kv-lifetime. that increases per-token work and amplifies tail.

rachel: agreed. also saw inter-tenant egress bursts on the rack that matched the time window. network queues got busy when many tiny handoffs happened.

dan: cost angle: this caused ~7% throughput drop for 30m -> cost-per-token up for customers on reserved capacity. not great for renewals.

maya: quick repro idea: run a canary with `stagger 20s`, keep same canary size and monitor `kv_cache_miss` and `egress_queue_length` over 10 drains.

jon: +1. add a metric for "slice hop count" (how many different GPU hosts served a single request) — should be low for latency-sensitive workloads.

sam: also, can we gate drains if rack-level egress saturation > 70%? current orchestrator only looks at host CPU/GPU.

infra-bot: suggestion recorded: add precondition check `rack_egress_pct < 70` to drain plan. created task INF-739.

elena: long-term: we should bias placement to minimize cross-rack moves for hot KV prefixes. cache-aware placement would help. we can use prefix heatmaps from the tracer.

rachel: note: customers on Dedicated expressed concerns — one mentioned timeouts during the window. we should offer a post-incident note and rollback option for dedicated tenants impacted by canary.

dan: FYI finance wants a short note on cost impact for last month; I'll assemble numbers if infra agrees to annotate the period.

jon: immediate action items: 1) revert canary placement flag for eu-west canary (sam) 2) run staggered-canary with 20s (maya) 3) add rack-egress precondition (infra team) 4) add slice-hop metric (observability)

sam: starting revert now. tagging @ops-team.

ops-bot: deploy: revert-job-3155551250 started by sam. estimated finish 2m.

maya: I'll run the staggered canary once revert finishes and post results. planning to capture `kv_cache_miss`, `slice_hop_count`, `egress_queue_len`, `p99_latency` for 60m.

elena: ping me the traces, I'll run heatmap diff to see if specific prefixes are getting shuffled.

sam: thanks all. we'll keep this thread updated with the metrics snapshot. feel free to DM if you see new alerts. :thumbsup:
